title: Time of Magic
description:
An add-on pack for Time of Conflict 2: a magic-themed army of mages, hags and sea serpents, with its own sounds.

To use it, copy the pack's YourUnitDefinitions, sounds and YourCustomMaps folders into your Time of Conflict data folder (by default Conflict 2.0 Data in your Documents folder). The game doesn't read them from its install folder.
